stem: A solid brass block has a density of 8.4 grams per cubic centimeter. The volume of the block is 0.05 cubic meter. What is the mass of the block, in kilograms? (1 meter = 100 centimeters and 1 kilogram = 1,000 grams)
solution: One cubic meter is \(100 \cdot 100 \cdot 100 = 1000000\) cubic centimeters, so the volume is \(0.05 \cdot 1000000 = 50000\) cubic centimeters.
verify:
cm3 = Rational('0.05') * 100**3
kg = Rational('8.4') * cm3 / 1000
assert kg == 420
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == kg and len(spr_answers) == 1
